meta.title: relocation — an actor joins a spot on another node
meta.subtitle: actor P moves to node B's User Spot room-42, carrying state and pending work

cards.title: An application-triggered move (JoinSpot)
items: actor P in node A's Entry Spot calls JoinSpot("room-42"), and moves to node B's User Spot "room-42" carrying its state and pending work along with it (bold arrow).
Once the move finishes, actor P follows the same execution rules as actor Q and R already in that spot. The call names only the spot id "room-42"; the framework finds the target node.
